tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba
༄༅/ /bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba

bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra dha rā ye/ dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos/ lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs nyams su len pa ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa rgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas gang yang rung bar lhan skyes bzhi ka'am/ gang rung nyams su len bya'i bris sku bshams pa'i mdun du dkar gtor pad+mas bskor ba dang mdun du mchod pa ci 'byor bshams/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sogs dang*/ rdor dril/ nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa 'du byas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ nang mchod/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bzhir hūm̐ oṃ khaṃ aṃ trāṃ dang*/ bāṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lngar gyur/ rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa rlung gis me sbar zhing bskol bas sa bon dang bcas pa'i rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i kha dog can du/ de'i rlangs pa las grub pa'i dngul chu'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga kha 'og tu blta ba/ de nyid kyang zhu nas bcud dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥyongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ aḥ hūm̐ steng nas steng du brtsegs te gnas pa las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams spros/ sems can gyi don byas nas snyoms par zhugs pas yi ge gsum la thim/ yi ge gsum yang dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces byin gyis brlabs shing myang*/

sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ pad kor rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*| |ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa rnams thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin stsol// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*| |yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces gtor ma phul/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/

snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod sprin lta bu dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dgyes pa bskyed nus su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+paṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= oṃ badz+ra shapad āḥhūm̐/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ bdag dus deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// gsum dang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur pa'i 'og tu/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba dang*/ gur gyi nang du bla bre dang*/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab par gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ pañdza ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐| oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor pa'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo kaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud// ces bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i nang du/ rdo rje'i ra gur 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba me ri dang bcas pa 'bar ba'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur| ces pa ni lhan skyes bzhi ka la rigs 'gre bar bya zhing*/ lhan skyes bzhi ka phyogs gcig tu byed na tshad med bzhi yan chad thun mong du byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā man chad lha so sor bya'o// dang po gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// spro dang bsdu bar byed pa'o// ye shes skad cig gis rdzogs pa| |rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa ni rtags pa'i rdzogs rim pa zab mo'i bskyed pa'i man ngag ces/ rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng du gsungs pa ste shin tu ches zab khyad che'o// bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhe sdang rdo rje mthing nag zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'khyud pa/ yab kyi zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du yum pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ do shal/ ska rags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs can mtshan dpes spras pa 'od kyi phreng ba 'phro zhing 'bar bar gyur| ces dang*/ gnyis pa bde mchog lhan skyes dril bu pa'i lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'jigs dus kyi gdan la/

rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig spyan gsum mnga' ba/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la zla phyed dang nor bu sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang dar dpyangs mgo phreng stag lpags 'phyang ba/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi phreng ba can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ ces dang*/ gsum pa dgyes rdor lhan skyes shan+ti pa'i lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad nyi ro'i gdan la/ rang nyid skad cig gis dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po khros pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar zhing 'khrugs pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu dang*| g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa gnyis bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngo bsangs/ gri thod 'dzin cing phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ yab yum ye shes kyi me 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ ces dang*/ bzhi pa dus 'khor lhan skyes rā hu la shrī bha dra'i lugs ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/

phyag gnyis kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ the'u chung ljang gu/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po| gsum pa dkar po can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyang bas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying ga mnan cing*/ g.yon dkar po bskum pas drag po dkar po mnan pa/ lha mo dga' ma dang u ma'i gdong dman pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i cod pan yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa| rus pa'i rgyan cha dang rin po che dang rdo rjes brgyan cing stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ sku stod la glang chen gyi ko rlon 'chang ba/ thal chen gyis byugs pa/ dar dpyangs dang mchod phyir thogs kyis spras pa'i pang du sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mnga' ba gri thod 'dzin cing*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga 'chang zhing gcer mo skra phyed rgyab tu grol ba zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab la sbyor ba/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rin po ches brgyan pa/ yab yum dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ ces dang*/ de nas lhan skyes bzhi po gang sgom yang gsal snang thon pas/ lha yab yum gyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying khar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ 'bar ba'i rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ pheṃ/ snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad dang dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ā lo kaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ lag gnyis rnam lnga 'dod kor dang 'khyud rgyas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi ngo bo dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go| |zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur te/ chu lhag ma las/ gsang 'dus kyi skabs/ yab yum gnyis ka rdo rje 'chang gis dbu brgyan ces dang*/ bde mchog gi skabs/ bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan ces dang*/ dgyes rdor gyi skabs/ yab yum gnyis la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan ces dang*/ dus 'khor gyi skabs/ yab yum gnyis la rgyal ba lnga sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan ces dang*/ thun mong du/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ de nas phyi mchod ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang bas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/

oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod ni/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ lha yab yum gang yin gyi sngags mthar/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ btags pa dang*/ oṃ sarba dharma pā la oṃ ā hūm̐ gis nang mchod thigs gtor dbul/ gsang mchod ni/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan pa bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ de nas snying gi bar mchog dga'/ de nas lte ba'i bar khyad dga'/ de nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor son pas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ 'khyud rgya byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ brjod/ de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms pas// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa| |de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// zhes gnas lugs bsgom/ bstod pa ni rdor dril dang bcas pas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces bstod la/

bskyed rim la mnyam par bzhag /slar rdzogs rim ni/ bdag nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi haṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir g.yas skor du māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ āṃ rnams dkar sngo ser ljang dmar/ snying gi rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su buṃ dkar po/ phyogs bzhir mdun nas g.yas skor du hūm̐ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ rnams sngo ser dmar ljang*/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su ā dmar po gsal ba rlung gi sbyor bas āḥlas gtum mo'i me sbar bas mi dge bcu po bsregs shing haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun bab pas yi ge bcu slar gsos shing*/ dkar dmar 'dres pas rtsa 'khor thams cad gang zhing yi ge rnams la dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar gyur/ ces yun ring du bsgom/ de las bsgoms pas skyo na/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng thon pa dhū ti'i nang brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar zhugs pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi zhal nas thon te rang gi zhal du zhugs shing 'khor bar gyur par dmigs la/ gsang 'dus yab la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ yum la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐/ zhes sogs/ bde mchog yab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ yum la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sogs/ dgyes rdor yab la/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ yum la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ dus 'khor yab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥham̐k+ṣ+malawaraya hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ yum la/ oṃ āḥbi shwa mā tṛ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so// de ltar lhan skyes bzhi po gang yin yang yab kyi bsnyen pa'i grangs ji tsam bzlas pa'i bcu cha tsam yum la'ang bzla dgos so// thun mthar bsdu rim ni|

thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rten gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu nas yum la thim/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang la bzhag /slar yang rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpa' rkyang gi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes thun mtshams kyi spyod lam dge ba'i bya ba gang dgos la 'jug go// lhan skyes bzhi ka lhan gcig byed na nang mchod byin rlabs nas tshad med bzhi yan thun mong du bya zhing*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā nas yongs su rdzogs par gyur gyi bar dang*/ spyan 'dren nas thun mtshams bar lhan skyes re re'i las de rnams re rer sbyar dgos shing*/ rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs sngags rnams rang rang skabs thob byed dgos so// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thog mar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor pa la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bdud rtsis bran la/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs rjes/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ gtor mgron gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid ro gcig par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa ma ma sarba sid+dhi pha la ku ru swā hā/ bdun gyis dbul/ mchod cing bstod nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/'dis mtshon nas lhan skyes gzhan gsum la'ang gtor mgron che ge mo'i dkyil 'khor zhes dang*/

i maṃ gong du lhan skyes gang yin gyi yab yum sngags sbyar bas grub bo// 'jig rten pa'i gtor mar bdud rtsi bran pa nang mchod ltar byin brlabs nas/ pheṃ/ dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ brjod/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ gong ltar mchod nas/ phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtsang sar phul/ 'jig 'das thun mong du yig rgya tshar gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs te/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bsrungs/ lhan skyes bzhi ka phyogs gcig tu byed na 'das gtor yang thun mong du phyogs gcig la byin rlabs byas rjes/ mngon rtogs kyi go rim ltar lha yab yum rnams rim gyis sngags re re'i mjug tu/ i maṃ sogs btags pa bdun bdun gyis phul rjes/ thun mong du mchod cing*/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// sogs 'dud nyi shus bstod la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms sogs/ bzhi ka la thun mong du byas pas grub bo// bsngo ba smon lam bya/ kha zas kyi tshe kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs sam/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying gar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'i dbus su lhan skyes bzhi ka'am re re rang gang byed gsal btab la/ lag g.yas blugs gzar dang*/ lce hūm̐ dang rdo rje las byung ba'i dgang gzar du bsams la/ bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor phul bas lha rnams tshim par gyur/

khrus kyi tshe bum dbang cho ga ltar bya/ nyal ba'i tshe snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdus nas bsam gtan gnyid kyi man ngag ltar bya/ ldang ba'i tshe rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi zhu ba'i glus bskul nas sad de 'gro don du lang bar bsam/ gzhan yang gtso bor bskyed rdzogs dang bzlas pa la dus 'da' bar bya zhing thun mtshams su dge ba'i bya ba kha ton dang sāts+tsha gdab pa la sogs bsag sbyang la 'bad cing*/ bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa thun mtshams la sogs pa thams cad du byang chub sems kyi kun nas bslang bar bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o// zhes pa'ang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mngon par rtogs pa spros pa cher gsungs pa de rnams deng sang snyigs ma lnga bdor tshe thung bas long med par bsams shing*/ khyad par blo dman rnams kyi 'jug pa bde zhing rang nyid kyang nyams su blang ba'i phyir/ 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i rigs las sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ rang lo so bdun pa'i steng lcags lug zla ba dgu pa'i dmar po'i tshes bcu la/ gdan sa chen po 'bri gung du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub bo// //sid+dhi rastu maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu//
